data.headline: Google to back building of nuclear reactors for data centers
data.summary: In a new agreement, Alphabet's Google (GOOG, GOOGL) will be supporting startup Kairos Power in its venture to build out small nuclear reactors to power AI data centers. Market Domination's Julie Hyman and Josh Lipton highlight Google and Kairos Power's long-term plan to build these modular reactors and have them ready for Google's use by 2035. This comes after Microsoft (MSFT) partnered with Constellation Energy (CEG) to restart the Three Mile Island nuclear power plant in Londonderry Township, Pennsylvania.
